title: bug: OOM with 1.71.0

I just faced an OOM running Homarr with 1.71.0 and memory limit of 1.5GB.
Typical usage is between 450-700MB

It happened when viewing the mobile dashboard, reduced items, but Docker container list and Beszel integration.

full_comments.body: Thanks for the report! One quick question to help narrow this down: when the memory kept growing, did you have Homarr open in more than one browser tab/window (or on another device), and was the Beszel widget set to **Live**? If possible, does the RAM stop growing after closing all Homarr tabs?

performed_via_github_app.name: ChatGPT Codex Connector
performed_via_github_app.description: Bring ChatGPT and Codex to your GitHub repositories.

full_comments.body:
Hi @ajnart ,

Indeed. My default dashboard is open on my MacBook (integration is beszel and Patchmon)

Regularly I open homarr on my mobile, few apps but Beszel and Docker integration. 

Beszel is set to live (I guess, what other options are available?)

I just did it again, same result
So I need to let my integrations go?

Or is the memory allocation of node.js the issue? 1.5G memory for the Container should be more than sufficient.
